sections.Profile:
"Silver," produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1957, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1957
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Women, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme
